text:
sam: Heads up — starting the night 'slim-kernel' hotflip across eu & ap. plan: 5% -> 25% slices over ~20m. deploybot will annotate progress. :eyes:

deploybot: deploybot: rollout triggered for engine kernel-slim:v3.2.1 -> traffic-slice small (5%). command: `deployctl rollout start --engine kernel-slim:v3.2.1 --slices 5,10,25 --window 20m`

ops-bot: ALERT: telemetry anomaly: ap-southeast-1 5xx rate jumped 3.1x on kernel-slim:v3.2.1 (since +2m). heatmap: https://internal.telemetry/heatmap?id=ap-southeast-1

jin: pausing the rollout for ap-southeast-1, please hold slices for that region. can someone grab the logs?

laura: pausing global for that region. propose rollback criteria: error rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase >50ms. if either hit, revert region to kernel-slim:v3.2.0.

deploybot: deploybot: rollout paused at 8% for ap-southeast-1 (slice 2). flag created on release:release-1234. :warning:

anya: quick log snippet from host gpu-12 (ap-southeast-1):
```
E2026-03-21T02:03:15Z runtime: kv cache miss -> fallback path
E2026-03-21T02:03:16Z kernel: matmul: shape mismatch fallback, emitting 500
E2026-03-21T02:03:17Z grpc: downstream 504 for /v1/generate
```

mike: sounds like a kernel edge triggered by dynamic shapes. Recommend targeted rollback in ap-southeast-1 back to v3.2.0 and run a 10% canary for 15m to verify. keep eu unchanged.

laura: agree with mike. also add a short note to release notes: "Reverted ap-southeast-1 to kernel-slim:v3.2.0 due to elevated 5xx during night roll; investigating matmul fallback path." cc @cs @sales if customers ping.

sam: action: ops, please run region rollback to kernel-slim:v3.2.0. I'll paste the command here for reproducibility:
```
# rollback ap-southeast-1 to previous engine
deployctl rollout set --region ap-southeast-1 --engine kernel-slim:v3.2.0 --pin
deployctl traffic set --region ap-southeast-1 --slice 10 --duration 15m
```

ops-bot: ops-bot: rollback job started (job id rb-20260321-77). ETA ~4m. pinned engine kernel-slim:v3.2.0 in ap-southeast-1.

deploybot: deploybot: annotated release-1234 with rollback note and pinned metadata.

ops-bot: telemetry: ap-southeast-1 5xx rate returning to baseline (within 3m of rollback). p95 latency trending down.

laura: :thumbsup: good containment. keep monitoring for 30m. if we see a second spike, escalate to postmortem.

sam: I'll update release_notes.md and the changelog with the rollback note and link to logs. closing thread unless further anomalies. thanks everyone.
